Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region

en: Its Roman school of law was one of the most famous of the empire.
Rebuilt after the civil war of 1975 to 1990, it lost much of its port area to an explosion in 2020.
it: La sua scuola romana di diritto fu una delle più famose dell’impero.
Ricostruita dopo la guerra civile del 1975-1990, perse gran parte della zona del porto in un’esplosione nel 2020.
